description: Get aggregated crypto news articles from multiple sources, with optional title search and filtering by category or coin. Articles are deduplicated so only the best source per story is shown.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return.

offset.description: Number of articles to skip for pagination.

q.description: Search article titles across the stored news corpus.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only return articles published after this time.

name: get_news

coin_symbols.description: The ticker of each `coin_tags` entry, in the same order (uppercase CoinGecko symbol), the coin's most recently synced symbol when it has had several, null where it has none on record. Null when `coin_tags` is null. Field added 2026-10-31: payloads captured before it lack it.

summary.description: Always null: Sharpe serves the headline and link, not the publisher's summary. Open `link` to read the article. The field stays so existing clients keep working.

total.description: Deduplicated stories matching the filters. Exact only when the scan reached the end of the corpus; otherwise a lower bound: stories before this page plus those returned, plus 1 while more remain.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: News feed
